relations.rationale: Leo showing up shortly after Mina is consistent with and slightly supports Ben also arriving a little later than Mina, as it fits a pattern of staggered arrivals.
Leo's work boots have no bearing on team membership.
Leo's boots are unrelated to the group's discussion about garden bed layout.
Leo's boots from an earlier job have nothing to do with traffic slowing Gus down.
Leo's footwear is irrelevant to the group's final assessment of the garden's condition.
Setting down chairs near the entrance has no connection to Dev's suggestion about herb placement.
Leo setting down chairs doesn't relate to his preference for working in mornings.
Leo setting down chairs near the entrance supports the later claim that they packed up chairs together, since chairs being present is a precondition for packing them up.
Dev's height relative to Ben has no bearing on whether Leo and Dev are on the same team.
Height comparison between Dev and Ben is irrelevant to Mina's team membership relative to Dev.
Dev's height compared to Ben has no relevance to packing up chairs later.

If Mina is on the same team as Leo, and separately Leo is not on Dev's team, this doesn't directly confirm or deny from claim 10 alone, but it is consistent with Leo not being on Dev's team since it says nothing about Dev.
If Mina is on the same team as Leo, and Leo is not on Dev's team (established elsewhere), this would suggest Mina is not on Dev's team, supporting claim 17.
Mina and Leo being teammates has nothing to do with traffic affecting Gus.
Team membership of Mina and Leo is unrelated to Ben's reminder about the watering schedule.
Mina and Leo's team membership has no bearing on the group's final agreement about the garden's condition.
Ben arriving a little later than Mina is consistent with, but does not establish, whether Ben arrived before Gus.
Ben's arrival time relative to Mina has no bearing on Gus apologizing for delay.
Ben arriving before Gus directly supports the claim that Gus arrived last of everyone.
Ben sorting gardening gloves is a separate activity unrelated to his reminder about the watering schedule.
